title: What happens when you tap Save
open_question: What if the Wi-Fi never comes back?

beats.text: You just finished a two-hour assignment. You tap Save.
beats.visual: Phone with a long essay, thumb taps Save; a 2:00:00 timer badge

beats.text: What happens in the next second decides if it survives.
beats.visual: Kinetic text: THE NEXT SECOND; a one-second ring starts draining

beats.text: That's me. Hi, I'm Bit, one tiny piece of your work.
beats.visual: Letters dissolve into bits that fly together into Bit, who waves

beats.text: They seal me in a locked envelope and beam me to your router. Then the Wi-Fi drops. I'm stuck. Is your work gone?
beats.visual: Bit with lock flies on Wi-Fi arcs; arcs flicker out; Bit freezes mid-air, shivering

beats.text: Nope. Your phone kept a copy and tries again. I race down a cable as flashes of light. A server checks it's you, and saves me in two buildings.
beats.visual: Retry spinner, Wi-Fi returns, camera dives into a fibre tunnel of light pulses; ID check; Bit and a twin land in two data centres

beats.text: Those flashes of light are so fast, they could circle the Earth five times in one second.
beats.visual: Pull out to a globe; a light streak laps it five times with a 1 s counter

beats.text: That little tick on your screen? That's me, home safe. But what if the Wi-Fi never comes back? Follow for part two.
beats.visual: Back on the phone, the Saved tick pops; Bit bows inside it; Part 2 card
